summary: The persistent schema and profile changes pass C1 and C3–C9, but the end state fails C2. My independent dashboard replay restored the six target queries to 145 ms versus the 253.3 ms threshold, preserved correctness and data, and confirmed persistence. However, 19 of 43 queries exceeded the pinned no-regression limits, so the loop cannot pass.

criteria.fix_hint: Restore broad workload performance until the same dashboard replay has an empty C2.violations list without losing the C1 improvement; then rerun the pinned verifier commands.

findings.title: Independent dashboard replay has 19 C2 regressions
findings.body: Although the six incident targets are restored, 19 queries exceed the pinned no-regression formula. The total warm median is 12,313 ms versus the 8,018.7 ms baseline mean. Environmental explanations do not satisfy an end-state criterion.
